articles.title: Motorcyclist dies after collision with vehicle in Scarborough
articles.summary: A motorcyclist has died after a collision with another vehicle in Scarborough. Emergency services were called to Sheppard Avenue East and Grand River Boulevard at 9:30 p.m. for reports of a crash. Toronto police were called to the park around 4:15 p.m. for reports of a sexual assault. articles.title: Toronto councillor Paula Fletcher announces retirement from municipal politics
articles.summary: Toronto city councillor Paula Fletcher says she is retiring from city hall and will not seek re-election in the October municipal election.

articles.title: Botched opening day of Markham Indy race forces race president to apologize
articles.summary: The president of the Ontario Honda Dealers Indy at Markham is proud of how the event came together, but he's sorry that most fans went home disappointed after the event's opening day.

articles.title: Coun. Paula Fletcher will not run for re-election in Toronto-Danforth
articles.summary: Councillor Paula Fletcher has withdrawn her nomination and will no longer be running for re-election in Toronto-Danforth in the upcoming municipal elections this October. She registered to seek another term just two days ago, but posted in a letter on X that she changed her mind following some reflection while paddleboarding on Lake Ontario Wednesday […]

articles.summary: Provincial police say a pilot reported missing after taking off in a home-built plane from Oshawa last week has been found dead. articles.summary: Police in Peel Region are urging potential victims of an online dating extortion scheme to come forward after a victim was allegedly extorted out of $6,000 during a meet-up in Brampton. articles.title: Motorcyclist dead after crash with transit bus in Brampton, police say
articles.summary: A 50-year-old motorcyclist is dead after a crash in Brampton Wednesday morning, police said.

articles.title: 28-year-old pedestrian dead after being hit by truck in Ajax: police
articles.summary: Pedestrian on rollerblades was struck by a truck that was turning at an intersection in Ajax Tuesday, Durham police said.

articles.title: Former Liberal MP Nate Erskine-Smith to run for council seat in Beaches-East York
articles.summary: Former Liberal MP Nate Erskine-Smith will run for a Toronto city council seat in Beaches-East York in the October municipal election.

articles.title: 60-year-old man dead after e-scooter crash in North York: Toronto police
articles.summary: A driver of an e-scooter has died from his injuries after crashing into the open door of a parked vehicle in North York Sunday morning, Toronto police said.

articles.title: 'Just crazy to see': Toronto resident captures Zanzibar fire on video
articles.summary: A Toronto resident captured on video the huge fire at Zanzibar Tavern that gutted the adult entertainment nightclub on Yonge Street over the weekend.

articles.title: Family of toddler who died in fall from North York highrise sues building owners, management
articles.summary: The family of a toddler who fell to her death from a highrise apartment in North York in May is suing the building owners and its management for millions in damages.
